title: Imperfect Verifiers, Exact Targets: Inference-Time Scaling for Continuous Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15281v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Verifier-guided inference-time scaling uses additional computation to score intermediate states and steer generation toward better outputs. However, imperfect intermediate verifiers can distort sampling, and repeated refinement alone does not ensure recovery of the desired reward-tilted distribution. We introduce Continuous-State Verifier-Guided Backtracking (CS-VGB), an inference-time scaling method for sampling from reward-tilted distributions with continuous generative models through repeated denoising and renoising. With correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions, the stationary distribution of CS-VGB at the clean checkpoint equals the desired reward-tilted target, even when intermediate verifiers are inaccurate. translated_title: 不完美验证器，精确目标：面向连续生成的推理时扩展方法
translated_abstract: 验证器引导的推理时扩展利用额外的计算来对中间状态进行评分，并引导生成过程朝着更好的输出方向前进。然而，不完美的中间验证器可能会扭曲采样，且仅靠反复精炼并不能保证恢复到期望的奖励倾斜分布。我们提出了连续状态验证器引导回溯，这是一种针对连续生成模型的推理时扩展方法，通过反复的去噪与再加噪操作从奖励倾斜分布中进行采样。只要去噪与再加噪转移被正确配对，CS-VGB 在干净检查点处的平稳分布就等于期望的奖励倾斜目标分布，即使中间验证器并不准确。在给定的正则性条件下，尽管存在验证器误差，CS-VGB 仍能指数级收敛到目标分布，并且获得一个干净样本所需的期望更新次数仅随通道数量线性增长。
tldr: 提出 CS-VGB 方法，通过正确配对的去噪与再加噪转移，使连续生成模型在验证器不完美的情况下仍能精确收敛到奖励倾斜的目标分布，且收敛速度为指数级、更新开销仅线性增长。
en_tdlr: Proposes CS-VGB, an inference-time scaling method that uses correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions to make continuous generative models converge exactly (and exponentially fast) to the reward-tilted target distribution despite imperfect intermediate verifiers.
